title: Diagnostic performance of artificial intelligence algorithms for detection of pulmonary involvement by COVID-19 based on portable radiography.
summary: A prospective observational study in which AI algorithms detect COVID-19 pulmonary involvement on portable radiography, with AUC comparisons against each other and against specialist assessment in a defined cohort. The AI role and evaluation fit the claim. The conclusion is limited to the reported study setting.
